r.name: Living Artillery

description.normalized: Corrosion Specialist (Passive): Gains 10% / 20% / 30% Attack Speed. Acid Shot (Active): Shoots acid at an area, revealing the area for 2 seconds. Then deals 80 / 120 / 160 (+25% AP +75% bonus AD ) magic damage to enemies within and reveals them for seconds. This ability's damage scales with the target's missing Health, increasing by 0% - 50% based on 0% - 60% missing Health. Enemies below 40% Health take 200 / 280 / 360 (+50% AP +150% bonus AD) magic damage instead. Subsequent shots within 8 seconds cost an additional 50 Mana (max 500 Mana). This ability's range increases by 200 units with each rank gained.
